description: Catholic University of Leuven: district heating datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catholic University of Leuven. Coverage: Catholic University of Leuven. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about district heating; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Données de réplication pour: Optimisation de la topologie non linéaire; Données de réplication pour: Optimisation de la topologie économique d; Données de réplication pour: Une topologie multipériode et une approch. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
